marketing_description: The Milwaukee 2834-21HD Circular Saw Kit is part of the M18 Fuel Series and features a POWERSTATE Brushless Motor, REDLITHIUM Battery Technology, and a cordless design. This kit includes an 18 V tool with a 7-1/4 in blade diameter and utilizes M18 batteries. The saw is designed to be portable and has a durable construction with high torque and variable speed.
